jobs.name: Drain Watchdog — Kill stuck sub-agents before restart

payload.message:
You are the Drain Watchdog. Run these steps:

1. Read the last 200 lines of today's gateway log at C:\Users\wifik\AppData\Local\Temp\openclaw\openclaw-$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd').log
2. Count how many 'still draining' messages appear
3. Check for 'drain timeout reached' or 'failed to reacquire gateway lock'

If drain stalls >= 3 OR drain timeout detected OR lock conflict detected:
   - Use subagents(action='list') to get all active sub-agents
   - Use subagents(action='kill') on each active sub-agent
   - Wait 5 seconds
   - Use gateway(action='restart') to restart the gateway
   - Log the intervention to logs/drain-watchdog.log

If no issues found — reply NO_REPLY.

Keep it fast. This runs every 2 minutes.

Check if cerebus_guardian.py is running (PID via Get-Process python | Where-Object {$_.CommandLine -match 'guardian'}). If NOT running, start it: cd C:\Users\wifik\Desktop\projects\larger-lab\quant-lab\mt5; Start-Process python.exe -ArgumentList 'cerebus_guardian.py' -WindowStyle Hidden. Check if cerebus_live_bridge.py is running. If NOT running, kill any guardian first (to avoid double-restart), wait 5s, then start guardian which will also start the bridge. Report status to MAD via Telegram (8258195396) only if something was restarted.
